meta.name: understand-explain
meta.description: Use when you need a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function, or module in the codebase

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入理解代码库中的任意文件或函数
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要快速理解不熟悉的代码模块
copy.tagline_en: Deep-dive into any file or function in the codebase
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly understand unfamiliar code modules

howto.what: 针对你指定的文件、函数或模块,Claude 会先在知识图谱里定位它,再读源码,讲清它在架构中的位置、内部结构、对外依赖和数据流向。前提是知识图谱已经生成。
howto.when: 当你想要某个文件、函数或模块的深入解释时触发。前提是项目里已生成知识图谱,没有的话它会提示你先运行 /understand。

say.text: 解释一下 src/auth/login.ts 这个文件
say.note: 返回它的角色、结构与依赖关系

say.text: 讲讲 src/auth/login.ts:verifyToken 这个函数
say.note: 说明它的内部逻辑、被谁调用、依赖什么
说明它所属的架构层和该层描述

howto.what_en: Given a file, function or module, Claude looks it up in the existing knowledge graph, reads the source, and explains its architectural role, internal structure, connections and data flow. The graph must already exist.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want a deep-dive explanation of a specific file, function or module. Requires the project knowledge graph; if missing, it tells you to run /understand first.

say_en.note: Returns its role, structure and dependencies
Covers its logic, callers and dependencies

say_en.text: Which architectural layer is src/auth in?
say_en.note: Names the layer and describes it
